responsibility: Implements GCC’s shared alias-analysis engine for both tree and RTL consumers. The file builds and maintains alias-set/TBAA relationships, including subset/superset structure for aggregates and special handling for pointer and universal aliasing cases, and provides the conflict predicates used to decide whether two memory references, expressions, or MEM RTXes may refer to the same storage. It also owns per-function RTL alias analysis state such as reg_base_value/reg_known_value discovery, scans instructions to infer stable base objects for pseudos, and exports diagnostics/statistics and helper hooks that feed dependence checks, memory-modification queries, and backend disambiguation decisions.
same_name_distinction: Implements the alias-analysis machinery declared in gcc/alias.h, including alias-set relationship construction, tree/RTL conflict queries, and per-function RTL alias state discovery; unlike the header, this file contains the actual analysis algorithms and state maintenance.
